sn48.56:1.1: bodhāyāti. ekadhamme patiṭṭhitassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitāni.
sn48.56:1.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cittaṃ rakkhati āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu.
sn48.56:1.6: tassa cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu saddhindriyaṃpi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati
sn48.56:1.11: evaṃpi kho bhikkhave ekadhamme patiṭṭhitassa bhikkhuno pañcindriyāni bhāvitāni honti subhāvitānīti.
